documentPurpose: Development-only reusable RSVP form-schema example synchronized with the approved spreadsheet-authoritative attendance model through the September 27, 2026 grouped Kids(n) clarification. The schema defines one reusable form whose conditional regions are driven by the validated invitation configuration, explicit named-invitee decisions, typed additional-guest allocations, the guest's current event-attendance selections, and backend-derived overall attendance. Plus1 allocations remain one-person Yes/No controls. An applicable Kids(n) source row produces one grouped unnamedChildren allocation whose Yes response reveals a required child-count selector from 1 through allocation.maximumCount. It contains no production invitation codes, real guest identities, stored RSVP answers, provider credentials, or protected administrative destinations.

documentationNotes.namedInviteeSource: Only safe specifically named invitee definitions returned in invitation.namedInvitees produce named-invitee attendance questions. Each object contains a stable opaque id and an approved displayName; specifically named children use this same roster mechanism. Private source-row identifiers and unrelated invitation data are not returned.
documentationNotes.additionalGuestSource: Only allocation definitions returned in invitation.additionalGuestAllocations produce additional-guest controls. Each public allocation exposes exactly the safe rendering fields id, kind, prompt, and maximumCount. A plus1 allocation represents one authorized unnamed adult/guest slot and always has maximumCount 1. An unnamedChildren allocation represents the complete grouped unnamed-child capacity for that invitation. An empty allocation array produces no additional-guest controls.

plus1.promptPattern: Will [Named Invitee] be accompanied by a +1?

unnamedChildren.prompt: We'd love for your family to celebrate with us this Mayday - will your kid(s) be accompanying you?
unnamedChildren.attendanceContribution: yes contributes validated count; no contributes 0
unnamedChildren.countSelector: When attending=yes, render one required whole-number selector from 1 through allocation.maximumCount.

documentationNotes.namedChildNonDuplication: A child already represented in invitation.namedInvitees must not also contribute to an unnamedChildren allocation. The latest authoritative source uses Kids(n) only for children whose names are unknown at invitation time.
documentationNotes.capacityInvariant: For every valid invitation configuration, invitation.namedInvitees.length plus the sum of invitation.additionalGuestAllocations[].maximumCount equals invitation.maximumAttendance.
documentationNotes.personAttendancePresentation: When the party attends Ceremony, Reception, or both, every authorized named invitee receives an explicit Yes/No decision; every plus1 allocation receives an explicit Yes/No decision; and each applicable unnamedChildren allocation receives one family-level Yes/No decision plus a conditional count selector after Yes. These authorized responses, not the age-category dials, determine actual headcount.
documentationNotes.attendancePresentation: Ceremony, Reception, and the invitation-specific decline statement are coordinated checkbox choices in one attendance region. Decline is mutually exclusive with Ceremony and Reception.
documentationNotes.overallAttendanceDerivation: overallAttendance is backend-derived as count(namedInviteeResponses == yes) plus count(plus1 additionalGuestResponses == yes) plus the validated count from any unnamedChildren response whose attending value is yes. The browser may mirror this calculation for usability, but it never submits overallAttendance as an authoritative client-writable field.
documentationNotes.attendanceTotalsPresentation: The four age-category values are presented as coordinated numerical dials or equivalent whole-number controls. Their complete sum must equal derived overallAttendance exactly.
documentationNotes.attendeeDetailsApplicability: attendeeDetails exists for every attending RSVP, including Ceremony-only attendance. Exactly one row is required for each person included in derived overallAttendance, including each child represented by a grouped unnamed-child count.
documentationNotes.dietaryFieldApplicability: dietaryPreferences is available within each attendeeDetails row only when Reception is selected. It is optional when applicable and is absent or cleared when Reception is not selected.
documentationNotes.blankLookupInvariant: Lookup returns schema and the validated invitation's limited safe configuration only; it never includes stored RSVP answers or stored confirmation destinations.
documentationNotes.operationalConfirmationCopyStatus: Provider-gated. Email is available. Production Text Message remains disabled until the selected provider's disclosure, authorization, backend-secret, sender-configuration, and production-flow requirements are satisfied.
documentationNotes.transactionalMobileNumberUse: A confirmation mobile number is operational RSVP contact data used only for the requested transactional RSVP confirmation and approved manual resend unless a later recorded decision separately authorizes another use.

conditionLanguage.always: Boolean true means the region is always present in the validated blank form.
conditionLanguage.attendanceIncludes: String event value that must be present in the current eventAttendance selection.
conditionLanguage.attendanceExcludes: String event value that must not be present in the current eventAttendance selection.
conditionLanguage.invitationArrayNotEmpty: Invitation-property path whose authorized array must contain at least one item.
conditionLanguage.derivedValueGreaterThan: Two-item array [derivedValueId, comparisonNumber]; true when the current derived value is greater than the comparison number.
conditionLanguage.confirmationOptionEnabled: confirmationOptions property that must be true before the related operational option is rendered.
conditionLanguage.fieldEquals: Two-item array [questionId, expectedValue]; true when the current page-entered value equals expectedValue.
conditionLanguage.fieldNotEquals: Two-item array [questionId, disallowedValue]; true when the current page-entered value does not equal disallowedValue.
conditionLanguage.all: Array of conditions; every nested condition must be true.
conditionLanguage.any: Array of conditions; at least one nested condition must be true.
conditionLanguage.allocationKindEquals: Two-item array [allocation kind source, expected kind]; used inside a repeated additionalGuestResponses instance to select the correct control shape.
conditionLanguage.allocationResponseFieldEquals: Three-item array [allocation response source, field name, expected value]; used for conditional grouped-child count rendering after attending=yes.

repeatableRegionLanguage.repeatFromInvitationArray: Create one control instance for each authorized object in the referenced invitation array. The stable source object's id is the submission key; approved display text and safe kind/maximumCount metadata drive presentation and usability constraints.
repeatableRegionLanguage.repeatCountFromDerivedValue: Create exactly the number of rows represented by the referenced derived value after the current named-invitee, Plus1, and grouped-child attendance responses produce a valid overallAttendance.
repeatableRegionLanguage.completeReplacementWhenSubmitted: When a repeatable region marked this way is submitted during a revision, the submitted array replaces the complete stored array for that region.

validationExtensions.allowedAttendanceSets: The complete eventAttendance value must be exactly one of the listed closed-set arrays, ignoring order where stated.
validationExtensions.authorizedNamedInviteeIdsOnly: Every named-invitee response key must match an id in invitation.namedInvitees; unknown or duplicate ids are rejected.
validationExtensions.allNamedInviteesRequiredWhenNewlyApplica: On an initial attending response or a transition from decline to attendance, every authorized named invitee requires an explicit yes/no answer.
validationExtensions.authorizedAllocationIdsOnly: Every additional-guest response key must match an id in invitation.additionalGuestAllocations; unknown or duplicate ids are rejected.
validationExtensions.allAuthorizedAllocationsRequiredWhenNewl: On an initial attending response or a transition from decline to attendance, every authorized allocation requires one complete response in the shape required by that allocation's kind.
validationExtensions.derivedOverallAttendanceFormula: count(namedInviteeResponses == yes) + count(plus1 responses == yes) + sum(unnamedChildren response.count where response.attending == yes)
validationExtensions.derivedOverallAttendanceMinimumWhenAtten: When eventAttendance represents Ceremony, Reception, or both, derived overallAttendance must be at least 1.
validationExtensions.derivedOverallAttendanceZeroWhenDeclined: When eventAttendance is decline, overallAttendance is 0 and attendance-dependent substantive data is cleared.
validationExtensions.coordinatedNumberGroup: Each age-category control is a nonnegative whole number. The UI coordinates the controls against derived overallAttendance while the backend independently validates the final exact sum.
validationExtensions.dynamicMaximumFormula: For each age-category control, the current UI maximum is derived overallAttendance minus the sum of the other three current category values.
validationExtensions.sumEqualsDerived: The complete attendanceTotals sum must equal the referenced derived value exactly.
validationExtensions.repeatCountEqualsOverallAttendance: When the party is attending, attendeeDetails length must equal complete derived overallAttendance.
validationExtensions.attendeeCompositionChangeRequiresReplace: If namedInviteeResponses or plus1 responses change who is attending, or if any unnamedChildren response/count changes, the complete attendeeDetails array must be replaced even when overallAttendance remains numerically unchanged.
validationExtensions.receptionRemovalClearsDietaryOnly: When Reception becomes inapplicable but the party remains attending Ceremony, preserve attendeeDetails and attendeeName values but remove dietaryPreferences from every stored row.
validationExtensions.nonblankTrimmedString: After ordinary trimming, the value must contain at least one character.
validationExtensions.maximumLength: String length may not exceed the configured maximum.
validationExtensions.backendAuthoritative: Browser visibility and client validation never authorize otherwise-invalid data; Express independently applies all configuration and complete-result rules.
validationExtensions.allocationResponseShapeByKind: Response shape is selected only from the matched allocation.kind. plus1 accepts scalar yes/no. unnamedChildren accepts an object containing exactly attending and count.
validationExtensions.plus1ResponseRule: For kind=plus1, maximumCount must equal 1 and the response must be exactly yes or no.
validationExtensions.unnamedChildrenResponseRule: For kind=unnamedChildren, attending must be yes or no. attending=yes requires a whole-number count from 1 through allocation.maximumCount. attending=no requires count exactly 0.
validationExtensions.groupedChildrenCountSelectorRange: For kind=unnamedChildren and attending=yes, the browser selector contains exactly the consecutive whole numbers 1 through allocation.maximumCount. The backend independently validates the same range.

requirementsBeforeEnablement: Verify the provider's then-current required sender-identification, consent, carrier-rate, opt-out/help, and other applicable guest-facing language.
Store provider credentials and sender configuration only through the protected backend secret boundary.
Update the guest-facing smsAuthorization copy to the verified production wording.
Test the completed production Text Message confirmation flow.
textMessageConfirmation.whenGateIsNotSatisfied: Production confirmationOptions.textMessage must be false; do not render the Text Message choice or invent provider-specific disclosure language.
textMessageConfirmation.schemaShapeInvariant: The permanent confirmationMethod value textMessage and smsAuthorization question ID remain part of the reusable schema vocabulary even while the production channel is disabled.

dependencyRules.rule: Authorize request fields and all named-invitee/allocation identifiers, validate invitation configuration kinds and maximumCount capacity, determine initial versus revision, merge submitted changes with stored values, preserve permitted omissions, resolve the complete eventAttendance state, resolve named-invitee, Plus1, and grouped-child responses, derive overallAttendance, clear values made inapplicable by the resulting state, require newly applicable mandatory structures or complete replacements, validate age totals and attendee details against the complete result, then store only if valid.
A valid complete eventAttendance value is exactly Ceremony, Reception, Ceremony plus Reception, or decline. Decline cannot coexist with either attending event.
An initial response must establish exactly one valid eventAttendance state from the approved closed set.
A named-invitee attendance control exists only for an object in invitation.namedInvitees. Every response is keyed by that object's stable opaque id; displayName is presentation-only.

For an initial attending RSVP or a transition from decline to attendance, each authorized named invitee requires exactly one yes/no response. On an ordinary revision that remains attending, omitted authorized named-invitee responses remain unchanged.
Every namedInviteeResponses key must be an authorized named-invitee id for the validated invitation.

An additional-guest control exists only for an allocation object in invitation.additionalGuestAllocations. Each allocation uses its backend-supplied id, kind, prompt, and maximumCount. kind=plus1 renders one Yes/No control. kind=unnamedChildren renders one grouped family Yes/No control and, after Yes, one required count selector. A party with an empty allocation array receives no additional-guest controls and cannot submit additionalGuestResponses.

For an initial attending RSVP or a transition from decline to attendance, each authorized additional-guest allocation requires one complete response in the shape required by its kind. On an ordinary revision that remains attending, omitted authorized allocation responses remain unchanged.

Every additionalGuestResponses key must be an authorized allocation id for the validated invitation. The matched allocation.kind determines the accepted response shape. Prompt text, raw Kids(n) source text, and any private source mapping are never authorization keys.

A valid invitation configuration satisfies namedInvitees.length plus sum(additionalGuestAllocations.maximumCount) equals maximumAttendance. plus1 maximumCount must be 1; at most one unnamedChildren allocation may exist for an invitation. A contradictory configuration must fail validation rather than be served to the browser.

When attending, overallAttendance equals the count of authorized namedInviteeResponses equal to yes, plus one for each authorized plus1 response equal to yes, plus the validated count from any unnamedChildren response whose attending value is yes. The browser may mirror the value for usability but cannot submit or override it.
An attending RSVP requires derived overallAttendance of at least 1. A full decline produces overallAttendance of 0.

attendanceTotals applies whenever the party attends Ceremony, Reception, or both. All four age categories are required on an initial attending response and whenever totals become newly applicable after a full decline.
Each age category is a nonnegative whole number. The complete four-category sum must equal derived overallAttendance exactly.

The browser presents the four age categories as coordinated numerical dials or equivalent controls whose current maxima reflect the remaining portion of derived overallAttendance. The backend independently rejects a complete age-total sum that differs from overallAttendance.

For a revision that remains attending, omitted nested age-category values remain unchanged and explicit zero is an ordinary replacement value, but the complete merged sum must still equal the newly derived overallAttendance.
attendeeDetails applies whenever derived overallAttendance is greater than 0, including Ceremony-only attendance. It is absent only for full decline.
When the party is attending, attendeeDetails contains exactly one row per person in derived overallAttendance. Every row requires a nonblank attendeeName of at most 100 characters.
dietaryPreferences is optional and limited to 1000 characters when Reception is selected. It is unauthorized when Reception is not selected.

When attendeeDetails is submitted, it replaces the complete applicable array. Omission on revision leaves the stored array unchanged only when attending-person composition is unchanged. Any named-invitee or plus1 change that changes who attends requires complete replacement. Any unnamedChildren response/count change also requires complete replacement because the identities of previously unnamed child rows cannot safely be presumed unchanged.
If the complete result removes Reception but retains Ceremony attendance, preserve attendeeDetails and attendeeName values while clearing dietaryPreferences from every row.

If Reception becomes newly selected without changing the attending-person composition, existing attendeeDetails names may remain unchanged. dietaryPreferences becomes available but is optional, so name re-entry is not required solely because Reception was added.
A complete decline clears namedInviteeResponses, additionalGuestResponses, attendanceTotals, derived overallAttendance, and attendeeDetails. Operational confirmation remains required.

For revisions, omission means leave the stored value unchanged only where the applicable field's patch rules permit it and no controlling attendance, composition, or applicability rule makes the stored value invalid or requires complete replacement.
confirmationMethod=email requires a newly entered valid confirmationEmail and makes confirmationMobile and smsAuthorization inapplicable for that submission.

confirmationMethod=textMessage is accepted only when confirmationOptions.textMessage is enabled. It requires a newly entered valid confirmationMobile and requires smsAuthorization=true when confirmationOptions.smsAuthorizationRequired is true.

Client visibility and usability validation do not authorize values. Express independently validates event attendance, named-invitee ids/responses, allocation ids/kinds/maximumCount, plus1 responses, grouped-child response shape/count bounds, derived overallAttendance, exact age-total equality, attendee-detail cardinality/composition/lengths, Reception-specific dietary applicability, operational dependencies, deadline, environment, and all complete-result invariants.

For kind=unnamedChildren, render exactly one family-level Yes/No question using the approved prompt. No means count 0 and no count selector remains applicable. Yes reveals one required selector containing the consecutive whole numbers 1 through allocation.maximumCount.

A grouped child response contains exactly attending and count. attending=yes requires a whole-number count from 1 through allocation.maximumCount. attending=no requires count exactly 0. Scalar yes/no, missing count, fractional/non-numeric count, negative count, and over-capacity count are rejected.

formSchemas.appliesTo: Every active invitation configuration produced from the authoritative Invitees List spreadsheet.

questions.label: Attendance

labelVariants.singular: I will be attending (check all that apply):
labelVariants.plural: We will be attending (check all that apply):

labelVariants.singular: Regretfully, I am unable to attend.
labelVariants.plural: Regretfully, we are unable to attend.

questions.helpText: Choose Ceremony, Reception, or both when attending. The decline choice is mutually exclusive with both attending options.

questions.label: Named invitee attendance
questions.helpText: This section asks for an explicit Yes/No attendance decision for each named invitee authorized by the validated invitation. Stable opaque ids authorize submission; display names are presentation-only.

questions.label: Additional guest attendance

unnamedChildren.promptRequired: We'd love for your family to celebrate with us this Mayday - will your kid(s) be accompanying you?

questions.helpText: This section appears only when the validated invitation contains one or more authorized additional-guest allocations. A plus1 allocation renders one Yes/No question. An unnamedChildren allocation renders one family-level Yes/No question and, after Yes, a required count selector from 1 through allocation.maximumCount. The grouped child control never repeats once per child and never collects child names; actual names are supplied later through Attendee Details.

questions.label: To better accommodate the seating & dietary needs of our guests, please list the total number of attendees in your party:

patchBehavior.replacementRequiredWhen: authorized attendance-response changes cause the complete merged attendanceTotals sum to differ from newly derived overallAttendance

questions.helpText: The four numerical dials classify the already-derived attending party by age. Their complete sum must equal overallAttendance exactly; the dials do not independently choose headcount.

questions.label: Attendee Details

replacementRequiredWhen: overallAttendance changes because named-invitee, Plus1, or grouped-child attendance changes
named-invitee or Plus1 composition changes even when overallAttendance remains numerically unchanged
replacementNotRequiredSolelyWhen: Reception is added while attending-person composition remains unchanged
Reception is removed while attending-person composition remains unchanged

questions.helpText: Provide one Attendee name for every person who will attend, including every Plus1 and each child represented by a grouped unnamed-child count. When Reception is selected, each attendee row also shows optional Dietary or allergy information. Ceremony-only attendance still requires attendee names.

questions.label: Confirmation method
questions.helpText: Required for every initial submission and revision. Newly entered operational values replace their stored counterparts. Text Message is rendered and accepted only when centralized configuration enables it.

questions.label: Email address
questions.helpText: Required when Email is selected. The complete current RSVP will be sent to the newly entered address.

questions.label: SMS-capable mobile number
questions.helpText: Required only when Text Message confirmation is enabled and selected.

questions.label: Transactional text-message authorization
questions.helpText: Provider-specific production authorization language must be supplied only after the SMS production-enablement gate is satisfied.

formValidationRules.rule: The complete eventAttendance selection must be Ceremony, Reception, Ceremony plus Reception, or decline. Decline is mutually exclusive with both attending events.

Render and accept named-invitee responses only for objects in invitation.namedInvitees. Every authorized named invitee requires an explicit yes/no response when person-level attendance becomes newly applicable.

Render and accept additionalGuestResponses only for objects in invitation.additionalGuestAllocations. Each allocation exposes id, kind, prompt, maximumCount. plus1 uses scalar yes/no; unnamedChildren uses one grouped family response with conditional count. Empty allocations mean no additional-guest controls and no accepted additionalGuestResponses.
A valid invitation configuration must satisfy namedInvitees.length plus sum(additionalGuestAllocations.maximumCount) equals maximumAttendance.
overallAttendance is backend-derived from named-invitee yes responses, plus1 yes responses, and any grouped unnamed-child attending count. It is not accepted as a client-writable field.
Ceremony, Reception, or combined attendance requires derived overallAttendance of at least 1; full decline produces 0 attendees.
All four age-category totals are required when newly applicable. Each is a nonnegative whole number and their complete sum must equal derived overallAttendance exactly.
The UI coordinates the four age-category dials against derived overallAttendance, while the backend independently validates exact equality.
Whenever the party is attending, attendeeDetails contains exactly one row per derived overallAttendance and every row contains a nonblank attendeeName of at most 100 characters.
dietaryPreferences is optional, limited to 1000 characters, and authorized only when Reception is selected. The visible label is Dietary or allergy information.

If named-invitee or Plus1 composition changes, or if any grouped unnamed-child response/count changes, a revision must submit the complete replacement attendeeDetails array even if overallAttendance remains numerically unchanged.
Removing Reception while remaining Ceremony-only preserves attendeeDetails and attendeeName values but clears dietaryPreferences from every row.
A complete decline clears named-invitee responses, additional-guest responses, attendance totals, derived overallAttendance, and attendee details before final validation.
Every initial submission and revision requires confirmationMethod plus the applicable newly entered destination and any required SMS authorization.
Client visibility and usability validation do not authorize values; the backend independently validates the complete resulting RSVP.
For kind=unnamedChildren, attending=yes requires a whole-number count from 1 through allocation.maximumCount; attending=no requires count 0. Other shapes and values are rejected.
The number of allocation objects is not used as additional-person capacity. Person capacity is the sum of allocation.maximumCount values.
